summary: Ported Conduit (ASP.NET Core 10 + EF Core 10 RealWorld API) to run on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL behind one config switch (Data:Provider = Sqlite | SqlServer | PostgreSql). Provider is resolved once at startup into a typed enum with fail-fast on invalid values; UseSqlServer/UseNpgsql/UseSqlite are conditional only at the composition root; PostgreSQL timestamps fork to timestamp with time zone; all 19 Username/Email equality lookups normalized with LOWER() for B6 parity; Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 10.0.3 added with lock files regenerated; docker-compose env passthroughs rewired. SqlServer and Sqlite behavior unchanged (R1). Build clean (0 warnings), 16/16 integration tests pass on InMemory; live SqlServer/PG verification not possible in this environment (stated gap).
